title: A Player Mode
shortDescription: Your five-person executive team. It plans your day and remembers your promises.
fullDescription:
A Player Mode is your five-person executive team: an Executive Coach, an Executive Assistant, a Chief of Staff, an Accountability Partner and a Mindset Coach. It plans your day, remembers what you promised and keeps it moving, so your head holds less.

HOW IT WORKS
• Answer easy-tap questions: about 4 minutes to a working plan. No essays.
• It builds your Mind, Body, Spirit plan and Tracks: your goals, your rules and your minimum day. APM suggests each piece; you change anything before you start.
• Every morning your plan is ready: one priority, a short start, then the day. Bad days shrink automatically. No catch-up, no guilt.

WHAT IT TAKES OFF YOUR PLATE
• Your agenda, ready every morning and prioritised.
• The Radar catches dropped promises before they are due.
• Goal to plan to daily steps.
• Coaching one question at a time, with five modes: High-Pressure, Executive Review, Recovery, Sprint and Deep Work.

THREE PLANS, EACH DOES ALL 5 JOBS
• Executive Roundtable: it plans and coaches you; you do the last step.
• Executive Suite: your whole life on one plan; it acts on your calendar when you tap yes.
• Autopilot: it moves and books calendar time on its own, inside rules you set. It never spends money.
Buying a plan never grants autonomy: you switch on each permission yourself.
Fair use: up to 300 AI requests a day per member. After that, coaching and planning keep working without AI, and inbox scanning starts again the next day.

FOR
Founders and entrepreneurs, operators with side projects, parents, athletes and competitors, students, creatives, and anyone in a transition.

SUBSCRIPTIONS
Executive Roundtable $24.99/month or $249.99/year (new members pay $9.99/month for the first 3 months; the first 100 members keep $9.99/month while they stay subscribed). Executive Suite $39.99/month or $399.99/year. Autopilot $79.99/month or $799.99/year. US prices; Google Play shows your local price before you confirm. Payment is charged to your Google Play account. Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled; cancel any time in Google Play > Payments & subscriptions, and access continues to the end of the paid period.

Terms of Use: https://app.aplayermode.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://app.aplayermode.com/privacy

A Player Mode does not provide medical, psychological, legal, financial or therapeutic advice. Results are examples, not guarantees.
